name: pqc-forge
description: Post-quantum signing (ML-DSA) and encryption (ML-KEM) CLI and library
author: saiteja799

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n lib,server,web -c blue,green,magenta "tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/keys.test.js dist/sign.test.js dist/kem.test.js dist/encrypt.test.js dist/cli.test.js
